Greenhouse gases contribute to the Earth's energy balance by absorbing specific wavelengths of radiation. Which row correctly identifies the type of radiation absorbed and the primary effect this has on the greenhouse gas molecules?

Radiation typeMolecular effect
ALong-wave (infrared)Increased molecular vibration
BLong-wave (infrared)Transition of electrons to higher levels
CShort-wave (ultraviolet)Increased molecular vibration
DShort-wave (ultraviolet)Transition of electrons to higher levels
